points: Per synced pair, PalletPoseNode::on_pair calls extract_detection_candidates, which stores source_index as that detection's slot in the Detection2DArray, then select_detection (pallet_pose_cpp.yaml default highest_confidence) returns one DetectionCandidate by value from std::max_element (higher score, then larger area). The other class-matched candidates are dropped when that vector goes out of scope. estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 runs once, and the chosen source_index is passed through as PoseResult.instance_id and, on failure, FailureResult.instance_id. Two early returns publish nothing: no candidate, and a depth_image_to_meters exception. On failure the only publish is publish_failure_diagnostics (failure_reason, input_rgb_stamp, input_depth_stamp); instance_id is not written. On success publish_ok_diagnostics emits chamfer_cost_m, plane_inlier_ratio, n_face_points, and those two stamps, and publish_pose fills PalletPoseStamped, which has no source-index fields (the message ends at input_depth_stamp). The stamps are this ApproximateTime pair's det_msg->header.stamp and depth_msg->header.stamp (queue 10, slop 0.10 s).

Measured stage-2 time is the chamfer grids inside that single call. two_stage_chamfer_search_v2 always runs: free coarse is 21 x 31 x 31 = 20181 (±10 deg at 1 deg, ±0.15 m at 0.01 m) and free fine is 13 x 25 x 25 = 8125 (±1.2 deg at 0.2 deg, ±0.012 m at 0.001 m). two_stage_chamfer_search_v2_with_prior runs unless lambda_eff <= lambda_floor 0.05. confidence is clamp((0.020 - free_cost) / 0.014, 0, 1) and lambda_eff is prior_lambda 3.0 times (1 - confidence), so the prior is skipped only when free_cost <= 0.006233333333333334 m. Prior coarse is 21 x 21 x 21 = 9261 (±0.10 m at 0.01 m, same 21 yaw steps) plus another 8125 fine evaluations, and that search is centered on the PCA init_pose, not on free_pose. The four grids are 45692 evaluations. Each of the four stages also evaluates its stage init once via chamfer_cost_v2 before the grid (the grid still visits the zero offset, so that init is a second data cost), choose_pi_ambiguous_pose adds 2, the anchor chamfer_cost_v2 adds 1, and the post-prior data-only chamfer_cost_v2 adds 1, so the common frame is 45700 chamfer_cost_from_rotated evaluations. OpenMP schedule(static) does not reduce that count; the critical section runs once per thread.

Each of those evaluations is O(N log N) with N=182. cached_prototype builds the default contour once: 1.20 x 0.14 m outer face plus two 0.47 x 0.10 m pockets at contour_spacing_m 0.03, using n = max(2, ceil(length/spacing)+1) per edge with the endpoint omitted (94 + 44 + 44). rotate_proto_into writes the N x 2 rotation into thread-local ChamferTls.rotated once per theta (out = proto * R^T without noalias, so Eigen materializes a temporary). chamfer_cost_from_rotated still assigns tls.translated = rotated and adds tx, ty on every pose, setConstant-fills the N distances, bilinear-samples all N, assign-copies them into tls.sorted, and std::sorts all N even though trim_fraction 0.10 sums only ceil(0.9*N) = 164. The bilinear loop reads column-major points(i, 0) and points(i, 1), so the two coordinates of one point are N doubles apart (1456 bytes). At 45700 evaluations the translation copy is 133078400 bytes and the sort copy is 66539200 bytes, before the sort itself.

Once per posed detection, before the grid: depth_image_to_meters convertTo-copies the whole depth frame into a new CV_32FC1 (camera.yaml depth is 640x480; 16UC1 is scaled by depth_scale 0.001). build_bbox_mask zero-fills a 1920x1080 mask and erodes it erode_px 2 times with a 3x3 kernel. sample_face_points then scans every depth pixel, O(Hd*Wd) = 307200, with a K_inv ray, an SE(3) into RGB, and a lookup in that full mask, using depth_m.at<float> and mask_rgb.at<uint8_t>. Accepted points land in per-thread std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d> (each bucket reserves Hd*Wd/(4*threads)) and are copied again, row by row, into points_depth_frame. ransac_plane_fit (up to ransac_iters 100, early stop at inlier ratio 0.85) allocates a residual array and a bool mask of length n_face_points every iteration, then copies inliers into a fresh matrix for JacobiSVD. plane_inlier_mask allocates those arrays again, and the pipeline copies the inliers a second time into plane_points_3d. project_points_to_plane_2d allocates an n_plane_inliers x 3 relative matrix and an n_plane_inliers x 2 result; PCA centres another n_plane_inliers x 2 copy. These passes are smaller than the 45700-evaluation grid and run only for the candidate select_detection already chose.

The distance image is built once per detection, not per pose. rasterize_points_to_mask sizes the mask from the inlier AABB plus padding_m 0.80 on every side at resolution_m 0.005. A cloud whose span is the nominal 1.20 m by 0.14 m face is 561 by 350: the padded y span is 1.7400000000000002 m in double, so ceil(span/0.005) is 349 and the +1 makes 350; the padded x span is 2.8 m exactly, so width is 561. Any inlier outside that span grows both axes. close_mask clones the mask, runs a 5x5 elliptical MORPH_CLOSE (close_radius_px 2), then connectedComponentsWithStats and a second full-size mask. extract_boundary_mask erodes with a 3x3 kernel. compute_distance_transform_v2 calls cv::distanceTransform with DIST_L2 and DIST_MASK_PRECISE and convertTo to CV_32FC1. geometry_core links Eigen3, OpenCV core/imgproc, yaml-cpp (camera load only, not the per-frame path), and OpenMP; the pose node adds rclcpp and message_filters.

Stage 1 is a separate process and is not where the unselected indexes are published. rtdetr_detector_node defaults to backend mock, which skips inference copies. detector.yaml and full_pipeline.launch.py set backend tensorrt at input 640 with max_detections 10. On that path image_to_rgb copies msg.data via bytes() into a 1920x1080x3 array, preprocess resizes to 640x640 and builds a float32 CHW ascontiguousarray (1x3x640x640), and TensorRTBackend.infer astype-copies then np.copyto into pinned host memory, memcpy_htod_async, execute_async_v3, memcpy_dtoh_async, and .copy() of labels, boxes, and scores. That host traffic is upstream of the pair delivered to on_pair. Writing the source indexes extract_detection_candidates already stored onto PalletPoseStamped and the failure DiagnosticArray is a few integers (at most max_detections-1 deferred slots). Calling estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 once per extra detection would repeat the 45700-evaluation search.
